_about: Workaround for models in the Oct 5 tufaelz update whose drawn geometry is out of sync with their stored bounds (measured 2026-10-06 on tufaelz_frozen_2026-10-06). Each factor scales the placed object so its drawn size matches its stored bounds (the realistic size); the object stays on the table because scaling is about its base. Measured from the silhouette's width in cm; verified after scaling (Golf Ball, a correct model, measured 4.3 cm against 4.3 cm stored). Remove an entry once the model itself is fixed.
